# POL-10 — Leave Policy

- **Document owner:** Priyanka Rao, Head of People
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Approval status:** Approved
- **Effective date:** 2025-01-01
- **Review date:** 2026-01-01
- **Supersedes:** POL-09 (v1.0, effective 2022-01-01 – 2024-12-31)
- **Related documents:** PROC-10 (Leave Request Process)

## Purpose

To make sure leave is planned and approved consistently.

## Formal requirements

1. All leave requests require approval from the employee's manager before the leave starts.
2. Leave of more than 10 days also requires approval from the Head of People.
3. Approved leave must be recorded in the HR system.

## Exceptions

None documented.

|---|---|---|

| 2.0 | 2025-01-01 | Manager approval for all leave, agreed at the people review meeting 2024-12-10 |
